reason: Plates come from one selected cow, but neither the paper nor its supplement says which of the 37 deposited rumen libraries is that cow, and the 6 inoculum-dilution libraries the methods describe are not identifiable in ENA. Choosing the library most similar to the plates would be circular, so the plates cannot be linked to their source (D-019). The paper names 515F/806R (V4) but prints the 341F and 907R sequences; the deposited reads are 252-253 bp, already primer-trimmed and merged, and start at the base after 515F, so the data are V4.

Clean design (leaf-wash community vs five media), but 454 pyrosequencing: homopolymer errors and a separate denoising path for 24 runs (4 environmental). Excluded by D-017; revisit only if it fills a habitat gap nothing else covers.
The original culture-enriched molecular profiling study, but no raw reads are public: the BioProject exists at NCBI yet links to zero SRA runs, and ENA returns no runs.
